# Examples (everything is INVENTED; outputs are real output of `scripts/mw.py`, regenerated by `dev/make_examples.py`)

These are examples of the interface, not results of any evaluation case.

| path | input | what it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `project/` | an invented experiment project: `config.yaml`, `train.py` (argparse + calls), `run.sh`, `logs/train.log`, `README.md`, `requirements.txt`, `results.csv` | `run.txt`: the brief (parameters with sources, `settled by run log`, three open CONFLICTs, environment, results, commands, what is missing), `check` of `draft_v1.md` (a flawed first draft: invented numbers, values that differ from the sources, training / evaluation values swapped, wrong versions and GPU, placeholder, generic limitation, unverifiable "same budget": 16 errors), `check` of `draft.md` (0 errors; 3 open conflicts and 8 author confirmations kept visible), `build`. `out/`: `section.md`, `parameters.md`, `questions.md`, `source_map.csv`, `review_checklist.md`, `result.json`, `brief.md`, `commands.md` |
| `zh/` | `case.json` with a task text, long lab notes (Chinese) and a `settings` dictionary; `draft.md` | the Chinese path: parameters read from prose, training vs evaluation batch size separated by clause, results in prose, `[[CONFIRM: …]]` markers turned into `questions.md` |

Reproduce: `python3 scripts/mw.py run --src examples/project --out /tmp/out`, then `check /tmp/out/.work examples/draft_v1.md`, `check … examples/draft.md`, `build … examples/draft.md --out /tmp/out`.
